items.rationale: The text between the quotes is " | ", a bar with one space on each side, so the result is NBO | 42. Without the spaces inside the quotes you would get NBO|42.
The & operator always produces text, so joining 1999 with an empty text gives the text 1999. It no longer matches the number 1999 in a comparison or lookup.
Every character counts: NBO-0123 is 8, then space, bar and space add 3, Canvas sneaker is 14, space, bar and space add 3 more, and 42 adds 2. Total 8 + 3 + 14 + 3 + 2 = 30.
& adds nothing between the pieces, so the two cells run together. To get a space you must join one yourself: =C2&" "&D2.
